alerts.reason: Acquisitions contributed 12% to 2024 revenue growth, exceeding the reported 10% increase (A). I expect that contribution to keep Q1 growth above -5% but to fade as Q2 comparisons include more acquired sales. Customers took longer to place capital orders, and several mills closed (C, D). Those pressures could push reported Q2 revenue growth to -5% or below. The acquisition dates and order delays make the exact quarter uncertain.
